name: Barrier Servant removes 2 enlighten counters to prevent its next damage
notes: Barrier Servant's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. The starting champion's Counters are patched with 2 enlighten counters directly (normally only reachable via a separate enlighten-granting effect) so the ability's cost (remove 2 enlighten counters from your champion) can actually be paid. Only the always-available 'prevent next damage to self' half is covered; Intercept is a combat-redirect passive and is out of scope. FIXED implicit-REST bug: this ability's printed cost (Remove two enlighten counters from your champion) has no [REST], but DoActivatedAbility() (Custom/GameLogic.php) set Status=1 as an implicit [REST] for every static ability of an ALLY/CHAMPION/PHANTASIA not in the hard-coded $skipAutoRest list (trace: cardID=xW6SZSlJX6 idx=0 static=1 before=2). The old expected_final_gamestate.txt silently pinned the rested state (Status 1); xW6SZSlJX6 is now in $skipAutoRest and the unit stays awake (Status 2), asserted explicitly.

rulesClauses: Remove two enlighten counters from your champion: The next time damage would be dealt to CARDNAME this turn, prevent that damage.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Barrier Servant's activated ability (printed cost: Remove two enlighten counters from your champion; no [REST]) also RESTED the unit: DoActivatedAbility() sets Status=1 as the implicit [REST] cost unless the card id is in $skipAutoRest. Fix: add xW6SZSlJX6 to $skipAutoRest (same fix as Tristan, Shadowdancer's Redirect).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php DoActivatedAbility() $skipAutoRest list / implicit REST for static unit abilities
